metadata.title: rate-limiter: remove obsolete redis_fallback config references
metadata.author: gandhipratik203

description:
## Summary

The `redis_fallback` config key is referenced across `plugins/config.yaml`, docs, the OCP helm chart, and several tests, but the current rate-limiter plugin (`cpex-rate-limiter`, the Rust port) does not recognize it. Operators using the shipped configs see a `"rate limiter: unknown config key(s): redis_fallback"` WARN at gateway boot and no behavior change. The docs describe a mechanism that no longer exists.

## Background

`redis_fallback` was a real config key in the in-tree Python rate-limiter plugin and was honored as documented (fall back to in-memory counting when Redis was unavailable). It became silently no-op when the in-tree plugin was replaced by the `cpex-rate-limiter` package. Behavior under unreachable Redis is now governed by `fail_mode` (default `"open"`).

We don't plan to reintroduce the feature: `fail_mode` covers the same operator decision space without the silent-degradation footgun of memory fallback in load-balanced deployments. If graceful degradation under Redis loss is wanted later, it should be designed as an explicit, observable mode — separate issue.

## Affected surfaces

| File | Action |
|---|---|
| `plugins/config.yaml` | Remove the `redis_fallback` line |
| `tests/performance/plugins/config.yaml` | Remove (3 occurrences) |
| `charts/mcp-stack/profiles/ocp/values-pgo.yaml` | Remove |
| `docs/docs/api/plugin-bindings-api.md` | Drop the `redis_fallback` row + remove from JSON examples |
| `tests/integration/test_rate_limiter.py` | Rename / tighten the misleadingly-named `test_redis_fallback_to_memory_on_unavailable_redis` (passes today only by virtue of the `fail_mode: "open"` default) |
| `tests/unit/.../test_gateway_plugin_manager.py`, `test_tool_plugin_bindings.py`, `test_tool_plugin_binding_service.py` | Drop `redis_fallback` from mock fixtures |

## Regression guard

Add `test_shipped_plugins_config_has_no_unknown_keys` (drafted in #4582, pulled out when that PR was scoped down): loads `plugins/config.yaml`, instantiates each plugin via the framework loader, asserts zero `"unknown config key"` warnings. Lands with the cleanup so the door stays closed behind us.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All references to `redis_fallback` removed from configs, docs, helm chart, and test fixtures
- [ ] Misleadingly-named integration test renamed or removed
- [ ] Schema-validation regression test added and green on `main`

comments.author: gandhipratik203
comments.body:
Starting-point branch carrying the yaml drop + the schema-validation regression test (originally drafted in #4582 and pulled out when that PR was scoped down): [`chore/rate-limiter-redis-fallback-cleanup-wip`](https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge/tree/chore/rate-limiter-redis-fallback-cleanup-wip).

Once #4582 lands, rebasing this branch onto `main` reduces it to the single `redis_fallback` cleanup commit, leaving room to layer the rest of the catalogue (perf configs, helm chart, docs rewrite, integration test rename, unit fixtures) on top.
